title: Language Model Tokenizers Introduce Unfairness Between Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'tokenization premium' by comparing the tokenized lengths of semantically equivalent sentences across up to 200 languages using the FLORES-200 parallel corpus to identify disparities in cost, latency, and context window utilization.

Evaluating tokenization parity between 'standard' languages and their respective regional dialects, pidgins, or creoles (e.g., Swiss German, Arabic dialects, Japanese dialects, and French-based Creoles) using parallel multidialectal corpora like SwissDial, MADAR, and CPJD.
